Who this class is for

For people who have read the books, and still feel stuck

  • Many people know every rule about food and still feel at war with it.
  • Some have tried to think their way out of old patterns for years.
  • Others are tired of hoping to love their body and want something quieter.
  • And plenty are simply curious how the nervous system fits into all of this.

Here's what you'll learn

Five ideas we'll explore in 60 minutes

Why insight alone rarely changes a pattern

The difference between understanding something and feeling safe enough to do it differently.

How the restrict-and-rebound cycle works

A plain-language look at why rules and urgency so often feed each other.

Where the nervous system comes in

What "regulated" means, and why the body has a say in what the mind decides.

Body neutrality, explained

Why a neutral relationship with the body can feel more reachable than body love.

Where coaching fits, and where it doesn't

How coaching works alongside therapists, dietitians and doctors, and when to reach out to them.

Meet Stefanie

Hi, I'm Stefanie Michele

I'm an occupational therapist with further training as an Integrative Health Coach and Intuitive Eating Counselor, and I'm a Somatic Experiencing practitioner in training. I know this work from the inside too.

42.3k people follow along on Instagram, and I host the podcast Full But Not Finished. My book, Regulated, is coming in 2027. In my coaching we work on four things:

The binge/restrict cycleBody neutralityThoughts, emotions and the nervous systemAn identity outside food and body image

This class is a gentle starting point for that work.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy or treatment?

No. It's an educational class from a coach. It isn't therapy, medical advice or eating disorder treatment, and it doesn't replace care from your doctor or a licensed professional.

Will there be talk about weight, food rules or numbers?

No. There are no meal plans, numbers or weight talk in this class.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch when it suits you.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, listen, and decide afterwards whether you'd like to go deeper.

Educational content, not medical advice. If you're struggling, please reach out to your doctor or a licensed eating disorder professional.

Why so many thoughtful people end up stuck here.

Hi [first name],

I hear this one a lot, usually from the smartest, most self-aware people I know.

Here's the thing. Thinking is a wonderful tool, and it's often the tool people have leaned on hardest. But patterns that live partly in the body don't always shift through more thinking.

That's what coaching with me is for: the binge/restrict cycle, body neutrality, the nervous system, and who you are outside food and body image. Worked through together, at your pace, alongside any care you already have.

Script 1 · "Knowing better"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Here's why so many smart, self-aware people still feel stuck with food."

Body

"They've read the books. They know the rules, and the reasons behind them. But understanding something and feeling safe enough to do it differently are two separate things. One lives in the thinking brain. The other lives partly in the body."

CTA

"I explain how they fit together in a free 60-minute class. The replay is included. Tap Sign up to save a seat."

Shot: talking to camera, same setup as your reels. On-screen caption: "Educational content, not medical advice."

Script 2 · "The nervous system"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"What does the nervous system have to do with food? More than most people think."

Body

"When the body feels under pressure, it doesn't always care what the mind has decided. That's not a lack of willpower. It's one reason so many people feel like they're fighting themselves. Learning what 'regulated' means can change how that fight feels."

CTA

"Join my free class, Why Knowing Better Isn't Enough. Live, 60 minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up."

Shot: talking to camera, the word "regulated" highlighted in dusty rose on screen.

Script 3 · "Body neutrality"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Body love isn't the only goal. For a lot of people, it's not even the best first one."

Body

"Body neutrality asks for less. Not loving, not hating. Just letting the body be a body, so it takes up less space in your day. For many people, that feels far more reachable."

CTA

"I talk about it in my free 60-minute masterclass, with live Q&A. Tap Sign up below to join."

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple slide: love / neutral / hate, with "neutral" circled.
